what: Stacked photo frames play in turn every (default 7) seconds — a mask combining a triangle and a circle opens with mask-size 0→100%, wobbling over 1s elastic.out(1,.9), while the photo grows straight 1→1.05 over 6s. At 5s the mask closes with elastic.in(1,.9), and the last 1s shows only the background. Two text pieces fly in choppily from off-screen positions over 1s steps(6), stick tilted, then return at 5.5s over .5s steps(4)

options.every: Length of one slide (seconds), default 7 — open + grow + close, plus an empty 1 second
options.ease · close-ease: Open/close curve (GSAP names), default elastic.out(1, 0.9) · elastic.in(1, 0.9) — the same curve as anime.js outElastic(1,.9) · inElastic(1,.9)
options.zoom: End scale the photo grows to, default 1.05 — 1 keeps it as is
options.steps · back-steps: Number of steps for letters coming in · turning, default 6 · 4
options.wait: Starts when an event with this name fires on window (end of loader, etc.) — if empty, starts as soon as it attaches
options.--fx-mask: (css variable, on a section or mask) mask image url — default triangle + circle. Each section can be given a different shape
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Layer count (cycles if more than one)
options.[data-fx-part=mask]: Board the mask attaches to (inside the section) — if none, the section itself
options.[data-fx-part=glyph]: (if any, around two) text pieces that fly in and attach — data-from·data-to="x y rotation"(Section box %·deg)
